approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Every resolved case ends with writing. Representatives summarise what happened, and the knowledge that would help the next person stays in the case rather than the knowledge base.
script.vo02: Incoming cases are routed on a guess at intent, so some of them travel further than they should.
script.vo03: It reads Customer service cases, Resolved case history. It engages you in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. And it can summarise the case and its resolution as it closes, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A representative closes a case and asks for the summary. The agent writes the resolution note from the conversation itself, then drafts the knowledge article the case should become.
script.vo05: Asked what still needs review, the agent separates the parts it drew directly from the case from the parts it inferred, and marks the second group for a person.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent flags the customer detail that must not appear in a published article, and the steps it could not confirm were the reason the case resolved.
script.vo_payoff: Representatives finish a case by resolving it, and the knowledge base grows without anyone curating it.
script.vo_helps: The result? Wrap-up writing lifted off the representative, a knowledge base that stays current, and cases reaching the right team sooner.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
